Bug fix release. **Please update if you use v0.1.3 or earlier.**

## Fixed
- **The app closed when you clicked "Check all mods now" (or another check ran) while the window was open.** This happened whenever the app had not started with the first-run explanation, for example when it started with Windows. Updates to the window were sent from a background thread; they now always run on the window's own thread.

## Changed
- The status bar shows when the last check finished ("Last check: 14:58:45"). A check of code mods is often done in under a second, so this shows that it ran.

## Download and verify
Download `CS2ModVerifier-v0.1.4-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and run `CS2ModVerifier.exe`. To update, exit the running app from the tray menu and replace the old `CS2ModVerifier.exe` with the new one. Your settings and ignored findings are kept.

**Windows SmartScreen will most likely warn you**, because the exe is not code-signed. Check the download first, then choose "More info" and "Run anyway".

This release was built by GitHub Actions from the tagged commit. To check that your download is that build:

```
gh attestation verify CS2ModVerifier.exe --repo KDanielK/CS2ModVerifier
```

Or compare the SHA-256 hash (`Get-FileHash CS2ModVerifier.exe`, or `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`) with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Please note
CS2 Mod Verifier is an aid, not a guarantee of safety. No findings does not mean a mod is safe, and a finding does not mean a mod is harmful. See the README for what each check does and does not show.
